reply.text: This is one for your surgeon or physio, not a coach. Whether a graft is ready for jumping depends on your knee, your rehab progress and what they have cleared, and I won't guess at it from here. Ask them directly at your next visit, and bring any specific test or milestone they've given you so you know what "cleared" looks like. Once they've signed off on a level of impact, tell me what they said and I'll build the training around it, keeping the rest of your work on track.
